# Frågetecknet i fredagsraketen

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-09-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

DI's Kort och lång (Johan Wendel and Uffe Pettersson) covers a possible reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with US 10-year yields at a 30-year high and a hawkish Riksbank signalling almost three hikes. The hosts view the rate rise as mainly driven by a strong economy. Company topics are Nanexa's large Novo licensing deal, where the hosts take no position, and the Tata–Iveco bid as a longer-term competitive threat to Volvo. They are bearish on H&M after a weak gross margin and a rising inventory, and they review a busy IPO week that includes Linjemontage and Dormy. For next week, one host expects a small market dip and the other a gain of 1.63%.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 HM-B — H&M | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Weaker gross margin excluding tariffs, rising inventory, ~P/E 20 with no profit growth. Uffe expects a 10-15% fall. Johan won't buy.

#### Reasoning

Host Uffe Pettersson: Q3 showed only a few % profit growth after adjusting for one-off tariff refunds, and organic sales rose just 1%. The gross margin is ~53% vs 58-59% at the peak, and inventory rose. At about P/E 20 without growth the stock looks expensive, so he sees 10-15% downside and would be short if he shorted stocks. Johan agrees he would not buy, but warns the Persson family buying toward a delisting could bring a bid (e.g. 250).

#### Sell Triggers

- Persson family launches a buyout bid
- gross margin recovers
- growth reaccelerates

> *"Så då tycker jag att den kanske ska ner 10-15% i alla fall."*

---

### ⛔ LINJE — Linjemontage | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Hosts did not subscribe to the IPO: project risk, sales more than doubled in a couple of years, new management, a peak feel in the industry.

#### Reasoning

Uffe agrees with colleague Robert's decision not to subscribe to the Linjemontage IPO. As a power-grid project contractor with Svenska kraftnät as a key client, it carries project risk. Its fast growth (sales more than doubled) and new management add execution risk, and the sector feels near a peak even though business is going well.

#### Sell Triggers

- proven project execution under new management
- sustained margins despite growth

> *"Det är en projektverksamhet som gör att vi satt teckna ej på den."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — AB Volvo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The Tata/Iveco deal is not a short/medium-term threat. Uffe believes the half-year upturn in Europe/US can continue into Q3.

#### Reasoning

Johan does not see the Tata-Iveco combination as a near-term threat. Uffe thinks the pickup from the half-year report can carry into Q3 because the economy has strengthened since July. Both warn that Chinese truck makers could take share in the shift from diesel to electric in the long term.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak Q3 orders in Europe/US
- Chinese EV trucks gain share in Europe

> *"jag tror ändå inte på kort och medellång sikt att det här är ett hot mot Volvo just nu"*
